title: CRM mobile app not updating the customer list
description: In the CRM app on my phone, my customer list is stuck at 3 days ago. When I log in from the computer, the up-to-date records show up.

worklogs.description: Cleared the mobile app cache, sent the user the re-login steps.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Please follow these steps: Settings > Apps > CRM > Clear cache, then log back in.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I did it, the first sync pulled in 100 customers but today's records are still missing.
